title: Lame-duck Congress might actually do something: speed up energy projects
summary: A massive permitting bill that could help energy projects come online much quicker and potentially lower utility bills for Americans is advancing with bipartisan support. And while it could be a catalyst for lots of clean energy, it could also speed up polluting projects and limit oversight of new data centers. With data centers demanding […]
llm_summary: A bipartisan “fast‑track” permitting bill is moving through Congress that would dramatically shorten the approval process for energy projects, promising quicker deployment of clean‑energy infrastructure and potentially lower utility bills. However, the same streamlined rules could also accelerate the construction of polluting facilities and reduce regulatory oversight for new data centers, which are rapidly expanding to meet growing digital demand.
